criterion: A per-organisation event table records type, recipients, payload, read state and delivery attempts
A member sees in-app notices only for event types whose permission they hold, and can mark them read
Per-user preferences choose channels per event type; in-app is always on and mandatory event types can't be turned off
Email delivery runs as a retried background job over HostUp SMTP, with an unsubscribe link in every non-mandatory email
Swedish texts follow DESIGN.md's Trust section
